notes: Pure text chat, no chart in this frame - OCR is clean and the statements are reliable. Dates DD/MM/YYYY (14/03/2026 = 14 March 2026). CONTRADICTION WORTH FLAGGING FOR THE VERDICT: at 08:47 on 14 March he says he is SHORT ('though i shorted at the region') while simultaneously asserting 'BTC rn should be at 150k' and blaming manipulation ('{ PPM }') - i.e. he claims the market is wrong rather than his position. This is an unfalsifiable escape hatch, not a call, which is why 150k is recorded under levels.other rather than as a target. The line 'Ace I shorted btc at this level at 40x lv, I remember doing it all by myself alone... I unders...' is a TRUNCATED REPLY-QUOTE of his earlier 09/03/2026 22:33 message (see IMG_7799), not a new statement, so it is excluded from statements; the '40x' leverage recorded in pnl comes from that quote and refers to the same 9 March short, NOT a newly opened position - do not double-count it. 'Ace After' at 08:55 is an attachment caption whose image is not in this frame. He references a 'grey region' and a 'green line' that are drawn on a chart NOT present in this screenshot, so those calls cannot be assigned prices from this image alone; needs_visual is false only because this frame is text, but the referenced chart objects require the matching chart screenshot to be priced. '7 60 2' is an emoji-reaction count row.
